title: Why Does Material Wealth Leave Us Feeling Empty? (1976-12-21)
description:
Feeling empty despite having everything? Discover why human evolution isn't complete until you connect your inner energy to the all-pervading power.

This foundational public program bridges modern science with spirituality, explaining how human evolution culminates in self-realization. Shri Mataji dispels dangerous myths about Kundalini, exposes false gurus, and concludes with a practical meditation to experience this inner awakening firsthand.

Key Topics:
• 🔬 The scientific reality of spirituality - why rationality alone cannot explain the parasympathetic nervous system or the leap in human evolution
• ⚡ What is actualization (Sākṣātkāra)? Understanding how we are like complex computers that must be connected to the universal power to function
• 🌙 Debunking Kundalini myths - discovering that your inner energy is a pure, motherly force that awakens spontaneously without causing harm
• ⚠️ The danger of false gurus - how true spiritual masters never exploit you for money or allow destructive habits to damage your subtle system
• 🧘‍♀️ Practical meditation session - experience thoughtless awareness and feel the actual physical vibrations of your Kundalini awakening

“Kundalini is your mother. She is with you every life you come. She knows all about you. She is a residual power in the coccyx, in the triangular bone.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• What is the true meaning and purpose of human evolution?
• How to safely awaken your kundalini energy spiritually?
• How to tell the difference between a true and false guru?
